name: Lugh
title: Orbital Search Team
description: The deputy leader of the Orbital Search Team of Polaris. Due to her peculiar hereditary constitution, she cannot feel pain. According to rumors, she has a hobby she keeps strictly hidden from those around her...
introduction:
Deputy Leader of the Orbital Search Team under Polaris Observation Council.
She works tirelessly on the front lines alongside her team leader Roberta to prevent observed disasters.

One of her distant ancestors wounded a divine being, resulting in a hereditary condition passed down through her family, and the condition that manifested in Lugh is congenital insensitivity to pain. She has been unable to feel pain since birth, and because she cannot feel pain, she also struggles to identify with the pain of others, leaving her with weak empathy. Her attitude and way of speaking make her seem cold, but in her own way, she is doing her best to blend in with others without feeling out of place.

She is an indispensable core member of the Orbital Search Team, and due to frequent night shifts and overtime, she rarely leaves the office, so aside from Roberta, no one really knows how she lives her daily life.

skills.name: Subdual Charm

levels.description: Throws a charm to attack the enemy. Grants self 1 stack of Chill. When used on self turn, if self has Swift Decree (Undispellable), uses Subdual Slash instead of Subdual Charm. Subdual Slash: Throws a charm to attack the enemy. On attack, damage dealt by Subdual Slash increases by 10%, 30%, or 60%, based on the number of Nova Burst activations. All damage increases based on Nova Burst activations are reset when the attack hits without activating Nova Burst or when Swift Decree (Undispellable) is removed after attacking. On attack, removes 1 stack of Snow Blossom (Undispellable) from self. After attacking, if self does not have Snow Blossom (Undispellable), removes Swift Decree (Undispellable) from self. After attacking on self turn, has a 100% chance to inflict Banishing Mark on the enemy for 1 turn. Effects that come with Banishing Mark do not trigger on additionally triggered skills.
